items.name: No. 4 Sable
items.line: Warm sand, iris and a little salt.
items.character: Our first. The salt and bergamot come and go in the first hour; then iris, dry and close to the skin, and the warmth of cedar.

items.name: No. 6 Ombre

story.title: Why I made it
story.text:
I grew up an hour from the sea, and the smell I remember is warm sand in the evening, with salt on my skin.

It took two years to get the iris right: dry, not sweet.

pages.title: Layering
pages.description: Which Verrière fragrances wear well together, and how to put them on.
pages.intro: Two of ours, one over the other. Start with the quieter one.

blocks.heading: Sable over Lin
blocks.body: Lin first, on the wrists. Sable once, at the neck. The salt of Sable sits on the clean musk of Lin like warm skin after a swim.

blocks.heading: Poudre under Ombre
blocks.body: For the evening. Poudre first, then Ombre on clothes rather than skin, so the rose and smoke stay apart until later.

blocks.heading: How much
blocks.body: One spray of each. Try the samples together before you buy a second bottle.
